text: The Seifert-van Kampen theorem can be proved in HoTT using:
choices: the pushout HIT — the fundamental group of a pushout is the amalgamated product of the fundamental groups
the encode-decode method for each space separately
explanation: In HoTT, the van Kampen theorem is π₁(A⊔_CB) ≅ π₁(A) *_{π₁(C)} π₁(B). It follows from the universal property of the pushout HIT applied to fundamental groups.
